items.t: Valve springs can break and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace valve springs under recall

items.t: Engine knock or failure after the valve spring recall repair
items.job: Replace engine with a used or rebuilt unit
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $7,000 for a 2013 engine failure. Push the dealer and Subaru for help if the recall work was recent.

items.t: Engine knock, stalling or sudden engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with a used or rebuilt unit
items.note: A broken valve spring caught early may only need cylinder head work.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling with cam timing codes
items.job: Replace cam timing (AVCS) oil control solenoid
items.note: Price is from RepairPal's figures for the Scion FR-S, which is the same car with the same engine. A software update alone may fix it, and a cam sprocket costs more.

items.t: Manual transmission noise, grinding or hard shifting
items.job: Replace manual transmission
items.note: KBB lists a dealer replacement at about $7,000-$7,500. A used gearbox or a rebuild at an independent shop costs less.

items.t: Clutch release bearing noise or clutch failure
items.job: Replace clutch kit and release bearing
items.note: Price is from RepairPal's figures for the Scion FR-S, which is the same car with the same engine. Total about $1,270-$1,650.

items.t: Chirping or cricket noise from the fuel pump
items.job: Inspect high-pressure fuel pump per service bulletin

items.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace low-pressure fuel pump under recall

items.t: Oil leaks onto the exhaust
items.job: Find and repair engine oil leak
items.note: RepairPal lists engine leak diagnosis at about $120-$180. Cost depends on which seal is leaking.

items.t: Water or condensation in the tail lights
items.job: Replace tail light assembly
items.note: Often covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.t: Rearview mirror shakes or falls off
items.job: Re-bond or replace rearview mirror mount
items.note: The HomeLink auto-dimming mirror costs more to replace.

items.t: Power window switch stops working
items.job: Replace power window switch or regulator
items.note: RepairPal lists an FR-S window regulator at about $185-$245.

items.t: Fuel pump clicks off early when filling up
items.job: Diagnose and repair fuel filler neck or EVAP vent

items.t: Airbag light on or passenger airbag turns off
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and passenger seat sensor

items.t: Radio screen fails and backup camera stops working
items.job: Reprogram or replace head unit
items.note: Reprogramming is cheap; a new head unit is not.

items.t: Engine failure from sealant clogging the oil pickup
items.job: Drop oil pan and clean or replace oil pickup
items.note: If the engine is already damaged, a replacement engine costs several thousand dollars. Usually under powertrain warranty.

items.t: Rear turn signals stop working in bright sun (recall)
items.job: Replace both rear combination lamps under recall

items.t: Fuel leak at the injectors or fuel rail
items.job: Replace injector seals and retorque fuel rail bolts
items.note: YourMechanic shows a full injector replacement on a BRZ at about $2,100. Usually under warranty on these years.

items.t: Fuel lines rub against the hood
items.job: Inspect and protect fuel line covers

items.t: High oil use with no low-oil warning
items.job: Oil consumption test, engine repair if it fails
items.note: Testing is done by the dealer and is usually free under warranty. Two engine replacements were reported, both covered.

items.t: Check engine light for timing correlation codes
items.job: Engine computer reprogramming per service bulletin

items.t: Check engine light for an engine computer fault
items.job: Engine computer reprogramming per service bulletin

items.t: Remote app features stop working after about a year
items.job: Telematics module update
items.note: Done free as a Subaru campaign.
